cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: Directly uses ZipEntry.getName() without validation, allowing path traversal if the zip contains malicious filenames with '../' sequences
Constructs file path by concatenating destination directory with untrusted filename, enabling path traversal attacks
Writes file content to potentially malicious path outside the intended extraction directory due to path traversal
